description.zh: 预测一串运动的下一步：先是方向与动作的重复序列，再是小人在格子轨道上的跳跃位置。训练的是把运动看成有规律的序列，并从已经发生的几步推出下一步。
description.en: Predict the next step of a motion sequence: first repeating directions and actions, then where a hopper lands on a numbered track. What it trains is seeing motion as a rule-governed sequence and inferring the next step from the ones already taken.

designModel.zh: 两段式：K1-K2 在符号通道（方向 → 动作）上识别重复单元（2 拍 → 3 拍）；G1-G2 转到位置通道，从固定步长的跳跃推进到步长每次加 1 的跳跃——后者要求先读出『步长在变』这一层二阶规律。
designModel.en: Two stages: K1-K2 recognise repeating units (2 beats, then 3) on symbol channels (direction, then action); G1-G2 move to the position channel, from fixed-length hops to hops that grow by one each time — the latter requires reading the second-order rule that the step itself changes.

ageRange.noteZh: 方向交替 3-4 岁即可；步长递增的跳跃约 7 岁。
ageRange.noteEn: Direction alternation suits ages 3-4; growing hops suit about age 7.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列。与 temporal-pattern 的区别：后者是时间与事件的先后，本模块是空间中的运动。与 number-pattern 的区别：跳格子虽然对应加法，但孩子看到的是轨道上的位置而不是算式。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds. Unlike temporal-pattern, which covers time and the order of events, this module covers motion in space. Unlike number-pattern, the track hops correspond to addition but the child sees positions on a track, not arithmetic.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.PATTERN.MOTION.SEQUENCE，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.PATTERN.MOTION.SEQUENCE, regardless of grade.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: direction 是箭头方向；action 是跳/蹲/转/跑等动作卡片；position 是在编号轨道上的落点。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: direction is arrow direction; action is cards for jump/squat/turn/run; position is the landing cell on a numbered track.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: alternate 两个方向轮流；three-beat 是 AAB/ABB/ABC 三拍单元；fixed-step 每跳 2 或 3 格；growing-step 每跳比上一跳多 1 格（1、2、3 → 下一跳 4）。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: alternate takes turns between two directions; three-beat is an AAB/ABB/ABC unit; fixed-step hops 2 or 3 cells each time; growing-step hops one cell further each time (1, 2, 3, then 4).

difficultyAxes.noteZh: K1 给 3 个选项，之后都是 4 个。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: K1 offers three options; later grades offer four.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 6 题，通过线 75%（5/6）。没有静态题库：generator.js 现生成，玩完立即换一批。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Six items per run, passing at 75% (5/6). No static bank: generator.js builds each set and a new one is swapped in when the run ends.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 两个方向轮流出现，判断下一步朝哪。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Two directions take turns; judge which way comes next.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 识别三个动作一组的重复（AAB/ABB/ABC），说出下一个动作。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Recognise a three-action repeating set (AAB/ABB/ABC) and name the next action.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在 10 格轨道上每次跳 2 或 3 格，预测下一跳落在哪一格。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Hopping 2 or 3 cells at a time on a 10-cell track, predict where the next hop lands.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 在 12 格轨道上每一跳比上一跳多 1 格，预测下一跳落点，排除『按上一跳长度再跳一次』的干扰。
levelMap.objectiveEn: On a 12-cell track each hop is one cell longer than the last; predict the next landing and reject 'repeat the last hop length'.

statistics.noteZh: G2 的 unchanged_step 干扰项专门捕捉『只读出一阶规律』：孩子看到了在跳，但没注意到步长在变。
statistics.noteEn: G2's unchanged_step distractor specifically catches reading only the first-order rule: the child sees the hopping but misses that the hop length is changing.
